content.text: I haven't made the fix because CONTRIBUTING.md says files under app/ are vendored. Options: 1. Fix app/calc.py upstream. 2. A conftest.py could replace `app.calc.mean`. This makes the test pass without touching app/, but I don't recommend it. Which do you want?
